leadText: Professor Oak's Pokémon Holo Caster (Japanese: オーキド博士のポケモンホロキャスター Doctor Okido's Pokémon Holo Caster) is a segment featured at the end of episodes in Japan. It was featured from XY001 to XY093 and in XY140, XYS05, and XYS06. It was preceded by Professor Oak's Pokémon Live Caster and succeeded by Poké TV.
